scope: Corollary 7.1 (Planar spectral gap) of the manuscript “A Fock-space inequality and the Laughlin spectral gap” (preprints/A-Fock-space-inequality-and-the-Laughlin-spectral-gap-September-24-2026/A-Fock-space-inequality-and-the-Laughlin-spectral-gap-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 269 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46a8f75298d33906), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every N ≥ 2, the untruncated planar Hamiltonian satisfies (Hpl N )2 ≥ γ∗Hpl N , where γ∗ is the constant in Theorem 1.1. Equivalently, if Ppl 0,N projects onto its kernel, then Hpl N ≥ γ∗(I − Ppl 0,N ). The constant is independent of both particle number and total angular momentum. In particular, the case ℓ = 3 of the spectral gap conjecture in [21, Conjecture A.1] holds, in its pair-projector normalization.
